complexity.notes: The loop invariant (target, if present, lies in [start, end)) is maintained correctly, and start can never exceed len(nums) before the final guard `start == end` short-circuits the index access. The bare `List[int]` annotation is safe on CPython 3.14 since PEP 649 defers annotation evaluation, though importing List from typing would be cleaner style.
complexity.summary: Classic iterative binary search over the half-open interval [start, end), narrowing on comparison with nums[mid]; after the loop collapses the range to one index, it verifies nums[start] against target.
